description: Make a static QR code for a link, text, Wi-Fi network, contact card, email, phone number or SMS, free and with no account. Returns a PNG and an SVG download link that the user can open, save or print; show the PNG link to the user. Static codes hold the content in the pattern, so they never expire and keep working without Snip. Use this whenever the user asks for a QR code.

data.description: What the QR code holds: a web address, plain text, a WIFI:T:WPA;S:<name>;P:<password>;; string, a vCard, mailto:, tel: or sms:. For a link the user may want to change or track later, call shorten_link instead and use its QR code.

ecc.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code can be damaged and still scan.

name: make_qr_code
title: Make a QR code
